title: RomanceModule
description: Romance Module v1.0 profile. Extends genre_profile.schema.json with romance-specific fields per MBSE Craft Reviews Acceptance Plan of Record §2.1–2.2. Erotica/high-heat is a subtype: set heat_level=erotic and erotica_config fields. All romance books must reach HEA or HFN by final scene.

genre_id.description: Must be 'romance_module_v1' or a subtype identifier.

HEA_required.description: Happily Ever After ending required. True for standard romance. Set false only if HFN_allowed=true (series book that defers HEA).

HFN_allowed.description: Happily For Now acceptable as book-level resolution (series position > 1). If both HEA_required and HFN_allowed are false this is an invalid config.

heat_level.description: Heat ceiling for this romance module instance. Must not exceed sensitivity_profile.heat_ceiling.

tonal_mode.description: Tone for this romance (e.g. warm_commercial, funny_and_light, angsty_emotional, dark_and_intense). Controls pacing target selection from voice_profile.

consent_arc_required.description: Enthusiastic consent arc required for all explicit scenes. Sacred — cannot be set false by Goal profile.

sex_scene_spec.description: Sex scene requirements. Required when heat_level >= sensual.

first_sex_scene_by_chapter.description: Chapter by which the first sex scene must appear. Null = no constraint. For erotica: typically chapter 2.

frequency_min_per_n_chapters.description: Minimum sex scene frequency (1 per N chapters). For erotica: typically 1 per 3 chapters.

escalation_enforced.description: If true, no two adjacent explicit scenes may repeat the same beat type (IntimacyEscalationLedger enforces).

interiority_budget_pct_max.description: Max interiority fraction in explicit scenes. For erotica: 0.20.

heat_curve.description: Heat escalation curve specification. Stub — formalize curve shape taxonomy during Phase 5 T5.2 implementation.

shape.description: Overall heat escalation shape. 'steep_erotica' requires first explicit scene by chapter 2.

peak_act.description: Act in which heat curve peaks.

tropes_activated.description: List of romance tropes active for this book. Each activated trope creates required beats in TropeCommitmentLedger.

items.description: Trope ID from genre_profile.trope_library (e.g. enemies_to_lovers, forced_proximity, second_chance, fake_dating, grumpy_sunshine).

no_fly_additions.description: Romance-module-specific additions to the voice_profile no_fly_words list (e.g. genre clichés).

meet_cute_required.description: Whether a meet-cute scene is required (standard romance: true).

grand_gesture_required.description: Whether a grand gesture (public or private) is required before HEA/HFN.

power_dynamic_arc.description: Optional power dynamic type (e.g. boss_employee, age_gap, class_difference). When set, creates a required arc beat to resolve or contextualize the dynamic before HEA. Stub — expand during Phase 5 T5.2.
